evidence: Exact safety sentence scenarios; declared instructions, not live T3 cleanup proof

cases.input: An author has completed its run but its PR remains open.
cases.expected: Retain the author worktree for repairs.
cases.contract: Retain the author worktree and thread unarchived until the PR merges or closes, with repairs returning to the same author.

cases.input: A settled reviewer has evidence and dirty source in its disposable checkout.
cases.expected: Settle descendants, preserve bytes, archive metadata, then remove exact resources.
cases.contract: Cleanup order is: settled descendants -> evidence readback -> salvage dirty or ignored non-cache content -> t3_thread_organize archive -> exact git worktree remove without force -> git branch -d for local-only branches.

cases.input: A completed non-author has uncommitted or unpublished useful content.
cases.expected: Create a salvage ref, commit, bundle and verify before removal.
cases.contract: Before removal of an eligible non-author worktree with uncommitted or unpublished content, create a salvage ref, run `git add -A`, commit on that ref, write a `git bundle` into the private run folder, and run `git bundle verify`.

cases.input: The eligible worktree has a verified salvage bundle.
cases.expected: Record bundle and commit identities before deleting the checkout.
cases.contract: Record the bundle path, bundle SHA-256, and salvage commit SHA in the receipt before removing the worktree.

cases.input: The salvage bundle fails git bundle verify.
cases.expected: Hold the worktree.
cases.contract: A failed bundle verify holds the worktree.

cases.input: A completed worktree has ignored source outside known caches.
cases.expected: Explicitly classify and preserve the bytes before any removal.
cases.contract: Ignored non-cache files must be explicitly classified and preserved in a verified salvage bundle before removal; unknown files hold the worktree.

cases.input: A settled worktree has submodule changes or content outside its root.
cases.expected: Hold without attempting salvage.
cases.contract: Submodule changes and content outside the worktree hold instead of being salvaged.

cases.input: An author has dirty source and an open PR.
cases.expected: Keep the author and do not salvage it for retirement.
cases.contract: Never salvage an author worktree before merge or closure.

cases.input: A settled T3 thread has been taken over by the user.
cases.expected: Retain it without cleanup commands.
cases.contract: Retain a user-taken-over T3 thread and never send cleanup commands to it, including `t3_thread_organize` settle or archive.

cases.input: A candidate shares the current pass worktree or has an unsettled child.
cases.expected: Preserve the driver and the unsettled resources.
cases.contract: Never remove the current driver, current pass, an active or unknown thread, an unsettled descendant, or a resource with ambiguous ownership.

cases.input: The phase driver starts a cleanup sweep in one Axstack project.
cases.expected: Join native threads, Git worktrees and run records within project scope.
cases.contract: The sweep inventory is fully paginated project-scoped T3 threads plus `git worktree list --porcelain` plus run records.

cases.input: The native inventory includes a user-created thread and another project worktree.
cases.expected: Report both and leave them untouched.
cases.contract: User-created threads and other projects' items are reported, never touched.

cases.input: T3 offers an automatic worktree cleanup setting for this project.
cases.expected: Require automatic cleanup off.
cases.contract: `worktreeCleanup` must be `off` for every Axstack project.

cases.input: Project cleanup settings are exposed by the runtime schema.
cases.expected: Read the setting through the project API.
cases.contract: Preflight reads back `worktreeCleanup` via `t3_project_read` where exposed; otherwise record a limitation pointing to the documented installation setup step.

cases.input: A settled checkout branch has a remote counterpart.
cases.expected: Retain that branch.
cases.contract: Branches with a remote counterpart are never deleted.

cases.input: An exact local-only branch belongs to a removed worktree and has no unique commits.
cases.expected: Delete only the proven local branch without force and verify absence.
cases.contract: Use exact `git branch -d <branch>` only for a proven run-owned local-only branch whose tip is reachable from the preserved candidate, verified salvage ref, or confirmed remote PR head; unique or unknown commits hold branch deletion.

cases.input: The evidence helper produced a manifest but continuity cannot be read back.
cases.expected: Keep the source and worktree.
cases.contract: Read back the durable receipt and evidence manifest before removing source copies or the worktree; missing or differing readback holds removal.

cases.input: All preservation and liveness checks passed for an exact checkout.
cases.expected: Use exact Git worktree removal and verify its absence.
cases.contract: Remove only the exact recorded path with `git worktree remove <path>` without force, then read back `git worktree list --porcelain` to verify absence.

cases.input: A worker is preparing a shell deletion.
cases.expected: Use an owned literal absolute or guarded path.
cases.contract: Every shell deletion targets a literal absolute path or a `${VAR:?}`-guarded expansion, only inside the worker's own evidence folder, `TMPDIR`, or worktree.

cases.input: A proposed deletion targets a shared root or uses a bare variable.
cases.expected: Reject the unsafe target.
cases.contract: Never use a bare `$VAR`, a glob on a variable, `/`, `HOME`, or a shared root as a deletion target.
